text: Absolutely love this place. It's affordable, but the work done for my teeth is professional and really good quality! They also don't try and market you extra stuff that's expensive and you don't even need. They just get the job done, and do it well. It has been my go-to dentist now for 5+ years. Highly, highly recommend

I had dental work done here with Dr. Natthee, and my face was distorted after the local anesthetic injection. Afterwards, I heard from the doctor that he had patients with even more severe distortions. Later, after using the dental workspace for a while, all the crowns broke. I'm so exhausted.

Both the doctor and the assistant were very gentle and gave excellent advice. The staff at the counter were very helpful and provided great advice. The clinic was clean and the prices were very good. I highly recommend this clinic.

The wait was very long and very expensive. I went to the clinic at 12:35 and left at 16:40. I went at 12:30 and the doctor at the counter said I had to wait 10 minutes for him to eat, but it was already 1 hour and he said there was a queue, but I didn't see any patients at the clinic.

I've been using their services for over a year now. My home is in Rangsit, but I'm willing to drive a long distance to get braces because this is the dental clinic I trust the most. Dr. Natthee and all the receptionists are very polite. I don't have to worry about tooth pain because the doctor has a very gentle hand. I highly recommend it.
The assistant is lovely and speaks well. The doctor is very kind. If you're unsure where to get braces, this is the place! Convenient location.
